title: NASA X-59 靜音超音速研究機
summary: 以NASA X-59低音爆研究目的為背景，學習外形、壓力訊號、模型相似與觀測證據；簡化聲壓模型不等同音爆預報。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use NASA X-59 low-boom research to study shape, pressure signatures, similarity and observational evidence; simplified SPL models are not sonic-boom forecasts. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 研究狀態的馬赫數：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mach number of a research condition: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 研究狀態的馬赫數 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mach number of a research condition and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 馬赫數是速度與當地音速之比；音速隨絕對溫度變化，使用地面音速解讀高空資料會偏差。
steps.instructionEn: Mach number is speed divided by local sound speed; sound speed varies with absolute temperature, so sea-level sound speed can bias high-altitude interpretation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非NASA X-59 靜音超音速研究機實際性能或製程：V=240 m/s，γ=1.4，R=287 J/(kg·K)，T=250 K。式 M=V/√(γRT)，基準結果 0.75724475 dimensionless。適用條件：乾燥空氣理想氣體、固定γ；非震波強度或音爆預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for NASA X-59 quiet-supersonic research aircraft: V=240 m/s, gamma=1.4, R=287 J/(kg·K) and T=250 K. Formula M=V/√(γRT) gives 0.75724475 dimensionless. Conditions: Ideal dry air with fixed gamma; this does not predict shock strength or sonic boom.
steps.failure: 使用攝氏溫度代替K會導致無意義的音速。
steps.failureEn: Using Celsius instead of kelvin yields an invalid sound speed.
steps.check: 將靜溫與總溫分開，確認速度來源及溫度感測修正。
steps.checkEn: Separate static and total temperature and verify speed origin and temperature-sensor corrections.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「NASA X-59 靜音超音速研究機」的「研究狀態的馬赫數：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Mach number of a research condition: Mechanism and observation” in “NASA X-59 quiet-supersonic research aircraft”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 壓力訊號正規化基準：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 壓力訊號正規化基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Normalization datum for pressure signatures and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非NASA X-59 靜音超音速研究機實際性能或製程：密度ρ=1.20 kg/m³，模型速度V=30 m/s。式 q=ρV²/2，基準結果 540 Pa。適用條件：低馬赫、定密度教學流；可壓縮流需修正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for NASA X-59 quiet-supersonic research aircraft: Density rho=1.20 kg/m³ and model speed V=30 m/s. Formula q=ρV²/2 gives 540 Pa. Conditions: Low-Mach constant-density teaching flow; compressible flow needs correction.
steps.failure: 壓管漏氣或把靜壓當動壓會造成速度偏差，先查管路再改模型係數。
steps.failureEn: Leaking pressure lines or treating static pressure as dynamic pressure biases speed; check plumbing before changing model coefficients.
